summary: ansible-sign project commands take the project root as last argument and use the first secret key in the default keyring unless --fingerprint or --gnupg-home is given; use -p/--prompt-passphrase without a desktop, and signing creates .ansible-sign/ with sha256sum.txt and its .sig.
questions: How do I choose which GPG key ansible-sign uses?
ansible-sign does not prompt for my passphrase over SSH
